source: ECMWF open-data IFS 0.25-degree oper (HRES) GRIB2 product
unit_note: the surface record is geopotential in m2 s-2; the mapping converts to metres with the declared scale 1/9.80665
time_policy: decoded at every valid time and required invariant
member_policy: oper is the deterministic HRES trajectory; no member identity exists
licensing: authored against the 0.25-degree ECMWF open data distribution (CC-BY-4.0, attribution required); the native 9 km HRES distribution is access-restricted, which is a data-licensing fact about the feed, not a capability limit of this profile
input_identity: dynamic file paths and SHA-256 values are owned by gpuwm-mapped-composition-inputs-v1
